component.name: Mass
component.summary: Music Assistant player with Material You theming

description.p: A desktop client for Music Assistant in the Material 3 Expressive style. It follows your matugen or DankMaterialShell palette live, or themes itself from the album art.

ul.li: Browse, search and control every Music Assistant player
Turn this computer into a Music Assistant speaker (Sendspin)
Time-synced lyrics, AI Radio DJ hosts and stations
MPRIS, notifications and a tray icon
